city.body: Tragedy unfolded in Kansas as the body of 33-year-old Venkatesh Doppalaudi, an Indian-origin man from Omaha, was discovered after his vehicle was engulfed by floodwaters. The harrowing incident took place on Saturday in Sumner County, leading to a swift rescue effor which went on for hours after his car and bag were found with no trace of him.
